test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A can do a job in 20 days, B in 30 days. They work on alternate days, with A starting the job. In how many days is the job finished?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Total Work = LCM(20, 30) = 60 units. Efficiency: A = 3 units/day, B = 2 units/day. Work done in 2-day cycle (A + B) = 3 + 2 = 5 units. Total 2-day cycles required = 60 ÷ 5 = 12 cycles. Total time taken = 12 × 2 = 24 days. **∴ The correct answer is 24 days.**
